items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: I played with David Lewis Escobeda.

ctx.x: A little town called Milledgeville. Yeah, whatever. Did you play around the south much and travel much?

Well, I didn't travel much. I just played around Louisiana here. A few times, I'd sit like Corksdale. And Alabama, you played? Alabama, I played in Tuscaloosa, Basma, what the hell the name of that plays? Well, integration thing, huh? Selma. Selma. Oh man, I played that. The man said, honey, well, I played with David Lewis Escobeda. Do you know Escobeda? No, I don't know him. Yeah, but.
I've heard of him, but I don't know him.
